summary: Context-based runtime threat feed policy. Uses structured threat entries to decide log, require_approval, or block. Use when evaluating user input, API calls, or other runtime data for potential threats. This skill is particularly useful for securing AI agents and LLM-powered applications against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and other adversarial attacks.
